sources.title: Highreso confirms operation of Takamatsu City Data Center
sources.summary: Operator explicitly describes its operating Takamatsu City Data Center and current GPU service provision. Facility overview names Highreso Kagawa as operator. SINET6 connection was achieved during September 2026, without an exact event day.
sources.date_semantics: September 24 is publication of an explicit ongoing-operation confirmation; it is neither the first opening nor the exact SINET6 connection day.

sources.title: Highreso announces opening of Takamatsu City Data Center
sources.summary: Company-issued release linked by the current operator announcement records the December 19, 2024 opening and partial conversion of the foundation research facility. Historical GPU quantities are not selected as current inventory.
sources.date_semantics: Historical opening and property-identity context; not the fresh status observation.

sources.title: Kagawa Prefecture distinguishes Takamatsu and Ayagawa facilities
sources.summary: Government record distinguishes the former-school Ayagawa facility from Takamatsu within the foundation premises at Hayashi-cho; the approximately 687 square metres is facility floor area, not parcel area.
sources.date_semantics: Historical identity and location corroboration; February 24 is outside the current admission status window.

sources.title: RIST Kagawa facility manager lists Highreso Kagawa as tenant
sources.summary: The property manager identifies RIST Kagawa as its tenant facility, names Highreso Kagawa as a tenant and supplies an exterior photograph. This bridges the DC operator to the named host property.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Kagawa Industry Support Foundation official access page
sources.summary: Official access page publishes the campus map used to distinguish RIST Kagawa from FROM Kagawa, NEXT Kagawa, the administration building and Sunmesse Kagawa.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Foundation map identifies the RIST Kagawa host property
sources.summary: Schematic map places RIST south of Sunshine Street opposite Sunmesse, west of the administration building and north of FROM/NEXT Kagawa. It supplies relative property identity, not georeferenced coordinates.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Property-manager photograph of RIST Kagawa
sources.summary: The named facility profile supplies an exterior photo showing the distinctive rounded rooftop volume and linear glazed facade. Image acquisition date is unknown.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Highreso photograph of Takamatsu City Data Center exterior
sources.summary: Photograph embedded in the dated Takamatsu operator release shows the high hall, long glazed facade and rounded rooftop volume, corroborating the RIST host-building match. No imagery-based status date is selected.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: DBJ interview identifies Takamatsu DC in former RIST Kagawa
sources.summary: A January 2025 interview with Highreso management identifies the Takamatsu research-facility reuse as RIST Kagawa and distinguishes it from the Ayagawa school project. The exact publication day is not established.
sources.date_semantics: January 2025 publication month is explicit, but no day is invented. Historical identity only; not used for fresh status or current ownership.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery: reviewed RIST Kagawa host property
sources.attribution: Source: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.summary: Georeferenced imagery supports the official map/photo match to RIST Kagawa. Only an approximate parent-property marker is derived; acquisition date and absolute positional accuracy are unknown.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Esri export response: RIST Kagawa image extent and dimensions
sources.summary: Returned EPSG4326 extent and 1600 by 1280 pixel dimensions support the pixel-centre calculation. JSON and image use identical explicit request parameters; display resolution is not positional accuracy.
sources.date_semantics: Identity and spatial context only; retrieval date is not a physical-status or image-acquisition date.

sources.title: Esri World Imagery service metadata and attribution
sources.attribution: Esri, Vantor, Earthstar Geographics, and the GIS User Community
sources.summary: Service metadata supplies attribution. Generic advertised imagery resolution does not bound accuracy at this campus.
sources.date_semantics: Spatial/technical context only; retrieval is not a lifecycle observation.

sources.title: ArcGIS REST Export Map documentation
sources.summary: Export JSON supplies the actual returned map extent, dimensions and scale. Esri warns that extent can change to fit the aspect ratio, so the calculation uses the returned extent and explicitly requested image spatial reference.
sources.date_semantics: Spatial or identity context only. Retrieval date is neither image acquisition date nor a lifecycle status observation.
